tip: Move — click a zone, head or pipe to work on it; drag any marker; Ctrl-drag or scroll to pan and zoom. Tap bare ground to show all.
Point of connection — click the meter or tap on the plan. The mainline starts here.
Manifold — click to drop a valve box. Zones go to the nearest box unless you put them somewhere else.
Mainline bend — click to run the mainline through a point. Select a node first to tee off it.
Lateral bend — with a zone selected: click on the pipe to bend it, off the pipe to branch out, or select a bend first to tee from it. Drag bends; Delete removes one.

Split zone — with a zone selected, click two points to draw a line across it. Heads or trees on each side get their own valve AND their own controller station. Wire them back to one station afterwards if they should open together.
Tree — with a drip or tree zone selected, click to drop a tree. The lateral runs to each tree and tees. Drag to move, Delete to remove.
Auto-route — run the mainline from the point of connection to every manifold in one go.
Undo point — take back the last mainline node placed.
Clear routing — remove the point of connection, mainline and manifolds on this sheet.
Laterals layer — show or hide every zone's lateral pipe.
Wire layer — show or hide the control wire runs.
